svg.title: Two-solver diagnostic: accuracy and output cost

cc:Work.dc:title: Two-solver diagnostic: accuracy and output cost
cc:Work.dc:description: Figure 3. Two-solver diagnostic, averaged across the two draw directions. Every policy point uses 128 paired states in the same 64 question groups. Accuracy and token values are transcribed point estimates; no uncertainty interval is inferred for these marks. Escalation pays for the direct draft plus thinking, including inserted closure tokens. The labels 4/64 and 24/64 count questions with positive realized utility gain in at least one of two draws at lambda=.05. These counts depend on the draw count and do not identify positive expected gain. Output tokens are not equal compute units across solver sizes; no cross-size latency or energy advantage is established.
